title: The Butterfly Forest: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Father told the children to stay on the path.
The large butterfly in the meadow was white.
A mother butterfly lays eggs on leaves.
When the new butterfly comes out, its wings are dry and strong.
The children found the path with the help of a bird.
Where did the butterflies lead Hansel and Gretel?
items.why: “The butterflies led Hansel and Gretel to a secret meadow.”

items.q: What do caterpillars need to grow?
What did the butterflies look like when they rose into the air?
items.why: “At once, dozens of butterflies rose into the air like a bright, fluttering cloud.”

options: At the edge of the forest

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Hansel and Gretel followed some butterflies to a secret meadow, where a talking butterfly called Lily taught them the butterfly life cycle. They saw eggs, caterpillars, a chrysalis and a new butterfly. When they got lost, the butterflies showed them the way back to the path.

items.q: What is the butterfly life cycle?

items.model: The caterpillar changes into a butterfly. It takes time.

items.q: How did the children find the path again?
items.model: Lily called the other butterflies. They flew through the trees and showed the children the way.

items.q: Have you ever seen a caterpillar or a butterfly? Where?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: The children followed the butterflies into the forest
Lily showed them tiny eggs on a leaf
The children saw caterpillars eating leaves
A new butterfly came out of the chrysalis
The butterflies showed the children the way back
